verdict.rationale: Bland's own TTS docs say developers can pick a built-in voice, clone their own from a roughly ten-second sample, and set voice defaults, so the core 'get the voice I want' need is documented. However, nothing shows how broad the built-in library is, and nothing shows support for plugging in multiple or third-party TTS providers. Missing for 10: evidence of library breadth or size, support for multiple or external TTS providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Pick a built-in voice, clone your own, and set its defaults.
A clone needs one clean sample of about ten seconds.
